messages.text:
Can you approve a review window for this cut that ends when we make our selection decision? We propose keeping the draft’s copying and disclosure restrictions in place with these limited permissions.

- Four festival programmers and one outside accessibility reviewer may view the cut under written confidentiality obligations. We can provide their names before access begins. Two of the five need one offline copy each on encrypted equipment. The other three can stream it through individual accounts.
- At the selection meeting, a programmer may give the board a short, confidential oral synopsis. Board members would hear the synopsis without receiving the screener or seeing clips.
- At the end of review, we’ll revoke viewing access and delete both offline copies. We need the copying permission to cover the platform’s 30-day backup retention after removal of the active screener. The backup would be unavailable for routine viewing.
- If selected, our catalog staff may receive the synopsis in confidence and draft the listing before the announcement. We propose that you review the final wording and that we publish only once you’ve approved it and the selection has been announced. Stills, clips and other publicity materials would require separate permission.

If you prefer to supply your own synopsis, we can use it for both the board discussion and the catalog draft. We’d need your written approval of the workflow before review begins.

We can approve a review window ending at your selection decision, subject to earlier withdrawal. Please confirm the following terms and send the five reviewers’ names, identifying the two who need offline access. We’ll approve the roster and workflow in writing before you open access.

- **Review access.** The four programmers and the outside accessibility reviewer may view this cut solely for selection, under written confidentiality obligations. Each screener must carry a watermark identifying its reviewer. Three reviewers may stream through individual accounts. The other two may each keep one copy on an encrypted device with backup and sync disabled. All five must refrain from recording, forwarding or making further copies.
- **Board discussion.** We’ll supply a spoiler-free synopsis for both the board and the catalog team. A programmer may present it orally in a confidential, unrecorded selection meeting. Please keep plot and cast details beyond the synopsis out of discussion and minutes, including answers to board questions. Board members receive no screener or clips.
- **Closure and withdrawal.** At the decision, or immediately on written withdrawal from us, stop viewing, revoke accounts and remove the active screener. Please designate a monitored contact who can act on short notice. Have both offline reviewers delete their copies and send us a deletion record identifying each reviewer, device and deletion date within one business day. Withdrawal also stops any pending catalog or publicity use of that cut. A replacement cut requires fresh written clearance.
- **Platform backups.** We can allow existing encrypted platform backups to expire within 30 calendar days of active removal, including after withdrawal. Access must be limited to disaster recovery. If a restore brings the cut back, keep it inaccessible to reviewers and remove it again without restarting the 30-day period. Please confirm the platform can meet that deadline and confirm expiry in writing.
- **Catalog and publicity.** If selected, catalog staff under confidentiality may use our synopsis to draft the listing. We’ll respond to draft copy within two business days. The listing may go live only after our written approval of the exact text and the festival’s official public selection announcement. If the announcement itself will identify the film, send us that wording for prior written approval too. Silence is not approval. Stills, clips, quotations and other excerpts each need separate written clearance for the specific material and use. The ending and cameo remain confidential after the announcement and public release unless we expressly clear disclosure in writing.

We accept the proposed terms, including earlier withdrawal. Access will stay closed until we’ve verified the technical controls and received your written approval of the roster and workflow.

We’ll send the four programmers’ names and the outside accessibility reviewer’s name, identify the two offline viewers, and provide a monitored withdrawal contact before review begins. We’ll verify the individual watermarks, streaming accounts and offline device settings before issuing any screener. At the board meeting, the programmer will use your synopsis and decline questions that go beyond it.

The platform’s stated backup retention is 30 days. We still need to verify that the deadline runs from active removal, that a restore cannot extend it, and that the platform supports encryption, disaster-recovery-only access and written confirmation of expiry. If the provider cannot confirm those controls, we’ll propose a different delivery method for your written approval before uploading the cut.

At the selection decision or immediately upon written withdrawal, we’ll stop viewing, revoke access and remove the active screener. Both offline viewers will delete their copies, and we’ll send a record identifying each reviewer, device and deletion date within one business day. Withdrawal also stops pending catalog and publicity use. Any replacement cut requires fresh written clearance.

If selected, our catalog staff may draft from your synopsis under confidentiality. We’ll obtain written approval of any announcement wording that identifies the film before issuing it. The listing will go live only after the official announcement and your written approval of its exact text. We’ll treat the two-business-day period as a response window only. We accept the separate clearance requirement for each excerpt and use, and the continuing confidentiality of the ending and cameo.

For the two offline reviewers, we can supply one time-limited copy each with an individual watermark on the soundtrack. Please propose a fixed expiry date. If the decision comes sooner or we withdraw the cut, viewing stops immediately. If review runs past expiry, please seek written renewal before further viewing.

Each offline reviewer must log receipt and every viewing session, including start and end times. At the decision, expiry or written withdrawal, the reviewer must delete the copy in the presence of a named festival staff member. A remote witness is acceptable if they can verify deletion from the identified device without seeing or hearing the film. The reviewer and witness must both sign the deletion record. Please send both records and the access logs within one business day of closure, even if a copy was never played.

Please name a festival lead authorized to certify account revocation and active screener removal, and identify the proposed deletion witnesses. On withdrawal, the monitored contact should immediately alert all five reviewers and confirm receipt to us. The lead should certify closure in writing within one business day. For platform backups, the lead may forward written confirmation from the provider or a platform administrator with access to the retention records. The 30-calendar-day deadline still runs from active removal. If witnessed deletion or logging is impractical for either offline reviewer, please flag that before delivery so we can agree on another method.

During the producer’s absence, we can designate an alternate by written notice giving their name, contact details and dates of authority. During those dates, either the producer or the alternate may approve the exact text of a non-spoiler catalog listing. Please send drafts to both. The two-business-day response window runs from receipt of each version, and publication still requires express written approval and the official selection announcement. Announcement wording, excerpts and other publicity remain with the producer. A withdrawal suspends pending use even if the alternate has approved the listing.

Please confirm these additions with the roster, expiry date, contacts and technical verification already requested. Access may open once we issue written approval for this cut and delivery method.

We propose **2 December 2026 at 18:00 Buenos Aires time (UTC−3)** as the fixed expiry for both offline copies. An earlier selection decision or written withdrawal ends viewing immediately. If review needs to continue past expiry, we’ll seek written renewal before further viewing.

The accessibility reviewer’s offline screen reader is incompatible with the original watermark. Could you supply a short test file with the proposed soundtrack watermark so we can check that the reviewer can follow both the film and the screen reader? If it works, we’ll use the individually watermarked copy. If it fails, would you authorize that reviewer alone to use a time-limited copy without the watermark, solely in our protected screening room, on one encrypted device with backup and sync disabled? The reviewer would use a separate individual login. The same receipt log, session log and witnessed deletion would apply. The other offline reviewer would retain the individual soundtrack watermark. We’ll report the test result and obtain your written clearance for the delivery method before opening access.

Press copy is due **one day before the ordinary review window closes**. If the film is selected, we propose sending the exact catalog text, announcement wording and any press copy as separately labeled items. Could the producer reserve a review slot and respond to the announcement and press wording within one business day of receipt? We request the same expedited turnaround for catalog text, which we’ll send to both the producer and the designated alternate during the alternate’s authorized dates. If the producer will be unavailable, could the producer preapprove exact announcement and press wording in writing, conditional on selection? The alternate’s authority would remain limited to the catalog. We’ll hold any copy that misses approval, including from external press recipients, and publish the approved listing only after the official announcement.

We accept the logging, witnessed deletion and certification terms. Each offline reviewer will log receipt and every session’s start and end. At closure, each reviewer and named witness will sign a record identifying the device and deletion date, even for an unplayed copy. Within one business day we’ll send both records, the logs and the lead’s written certification of account revocation and active removal. On withdrawal, the monitored contact will immediately acknowledge receipt, alert all five reviewers and halt pending publicity use.

The five names, offline assignments, authorized lead, monitored contact details and deletion witnesses are still pending. We’ll submit them with the technical verification, including the provider’s ability to meet the 30-calendar-day backup deadline measured from active removal even after a restore. The lead will forward written confirmation of expiry from the provider or platform administrator. Access remains pending your written approval for this cut and delivery method.

We accept **2 December 2026 at 18:00 Buenos Aires time (UTC−3)** as the expiry for both offline copies. An earlier selection decision or written withdrawal ends all viewing immediately. Any extension requires our written approval before viewing resumes.

We’ll supply a short test file with representative dialogue and the proposed soundtrack watermark, using material that reveals neither the ending nor the cameo. Please test it with the reviewer’s screen reader on the intended device and report whether both the dialogue and screen reader are intelligible. If the test fails, we can adjust the watermark and retest. An unwatermarked screening-room copy would require separate rights-holder approval, even with the controls you propose. Please keep that option on hold pending an express written exception for that reviewer and device.

For the press deadline, please send the exact proposed announcement, press wording and catalog listing as separate items **before the selection decision**, marked conditional on selection. We can reserve a review slot if you confirm the submission time and the exact press deadline in Buenos Aires time. We can aim for a one-business-day response on all three items. Our commitment remains two business days from receipt of each version. For a firm deadline, please send drafts two business days ahead.

The producer may preapprove exact announcement and press wording in writing, conditional on selection. Once selection is confirmed, the festival may issue the approved announcement. Approved press wording may go to external recipients once the official announcement is public. An earlier press handoff, even under embargo, requires separate written approval. The catalog listing may publish after the announcement with exact-text approval from the producer or the catalog alternate named in our written designation during its effective dates. Edits require fresh approval, and withdrawal suspends pending use of preapproved wording.

The proposed deletion, certification and backup arrangements are accepted. The compatibility test may proceed with the test file. Access to the cut still requires our written sign-off after we receive the roster and offline assignments, named lead and witnesses, monitored withdrawal contact, test result and technical verification.

For scheduling, we propose submitting all three drafts by **Thursday, 26 November at 12:00 Buenos Aires time (UTC−3)** and using **Tuesday, 1 December at 18:00** in the same time zone as the press deadline. The deadline date reflects the one-day lead. The exact hour is our proposal, pending confirmation from the press desk. Can you reserve a review slot on that basis? Please send the spoiler-free synopsis so we can prepare the three exact texts as separate items, each marked conditional on selection. We accept the two-business-day response window for each version.

If the press desk requires external delivery before the public announcement, we request separate written approval from the producer for an embargoed handoff **after selection is confirmed**. We would submit the named recipients, exact approved press text, handoff time and embargo lift time for that approval. Without it, we’ll hold external delivery until the announcement is public. The catalog alternate’s authority remains limited to the exact listing text during the dates of the written designation.

Please send the test file. The accessibility reviewer will test it on the intended device and report whether the dialogue and the screen reader are each intelligible. If either is difficult to follow, we’ll test an adjusted watermark. If that also fails, we’ll seek the rights holder’s express written exception for that reviewer and device in the protected room with the separate login.

The **2 December at 18:00** offline expiry and the earlier decision or withdrawal triggers are agreed. Before anyone views the cut, we’ll submit the roster and offline assignments, named lead and deletion witnesses, monitored withdrawal contact, test result and technical verification, and await your written sign-off.

We reserve the producer’s review slot for the three separately labeled drafts due **Thursday, 26 November at 12:00 Buenos Aires time**. For versions received by then, we’ll respond by **Monday, 30 November at 12:00** in the same time zone. Each revised version has its own two-business-day response window. We’ll plan around the provisional press deadline of **Tuesday, 1 December at 18:00**. Please send the confirmed hour when the press desk sets it.

The approved spoiler-free synopsis and soundtrack-watermarked test file are both pending delivery from production. For scheduling, you may submit the three drafts with a placeholder for the synopsis. We can review the surrounding wording in the reserved slot and clear the exact completed texts once you insert the approved synopsis. The accessibility test can proceed when the sample arrives. Access to the cut still requires our separate written sign-off.

If early press delivery proves necessary after selection, please submit the named recipients, exact text, proposed handoff and lift times, and each recipient’s written agreement to hold publication until the official announcement is public, including if it is delayed. The producer will decide that handoff separately in writing. If we withdraw after handoff but before announcement, please notify those recipients immediately to continue holding publication and confirm receipt of that notice. Until the producer expressly approves an early handoff, external delivery must wait for the public announcement.

Please use the following drafts for the reserved review slot. All three are conditional on selection. Bracketed text marks details still to be supplied.

- **Official announcement** — “[Festival name] has selected [film title] for its program.”
- **Press wording** — “[Film title] has been selected for [festival name]. [Approved spoiler-free synopsis.]”
- **Catalog listing** — “[Film title] — [Approved spoiler-free synopsis.]”

We’ll submit the completed texts for exact-wording approval. Each revision starts its own two-business-day response window. We’ll confirm the press deadline hour when the desk sets it.

We accept the early handoff terms. If delivery before the announcement is necessary after selection, we’ll submit the named recipients, exact text, handoff and lift times, and each recipient’s written agreement to hold publication until the announcement is public, including if it is delayed. We’ll await the producer’s separate written approval before delivery. If withdrawal follows handoff but precedes announcement, we’ll immediately instruct each recipient to continue holding publication and obtain confirmation of receipt.

The accessibility test awaits the sample from production. We’ll report whether both the dialogue and screen reader are intelligible on the intended device. Access to the cut awaits your written sign-off on the roster, controls and delivery method.

We’ve reviewed all three drafts. The announcement sentence, press wording and catalog format are acceptable as drafted. Please submit the completed versions for exact-wording approval once the festival name, film title and approved synopsis are in place. You may submit the completed announcement first, since it does not depend on the synopsis. Each completed version has its own two-business-day response window. Publication remains conditional on selection and the agreed release terms.

Production still owes you the spoiler-free synopsis and the soundtrack-watermarked test file. The accessibility test can proceed when the sample arrives. Access to the cut remains pending our written sign-off on the named reviewers, controls and delivery method.
